metadata.description: Relicmark's plugin for Claude Code, published by Conviviera Corp.

plugins.name: relicmark-ledger
plugins.description: Look up a graded trading card on Relicmark and get its composite price, an estimate built only from verified, source-linked sales of that exact card and grade, with the sale rows behind it. Read only, no sign-in. Not an appraisal and not authentication.
